representation_rule.text: Form CMS-1696 appoints a representative to act for a party on a claim or appeal. It is valid for one year from the date both the party and the representative sign it, and, unless revoked, for the duration of the claim or appeal it was filed with. Fee approval is not required when the party being represented is a provider or supplier. A MAC may dismiss a redetermination request when the representative is not appointed properly.
representation_rule.demo_use: Our policy in the demo: when we file an appeal for a practice as its appointed representative, the letter says so and a signed CMS-1696 goes with it. When the practice signs and files the appeal itself, no form is needed. Melvin confirms this policy with the lawyer before real use.

missing_info.label: Missing information
missing_info.plain: The payer says something was missing, usually a record it asked for.
missing_info.prevent: Send the signed visit note with claims for this kind of service, and answer the insurer's record requests quickly.

medical_necessity.label: Medical necessity
medical_necessity.plain: The payer says the service was not needed, or not covered for this diagnosis or this often.
medical_necessity.prevent: Write the reason in the visit note: the symptoms, how long they lasted and what was tried first. Check the insurer's coverage policy for the diagnosis codes it accepts.

coding.label: Coding
coding.plain: The payer says a code, modifier or diagnosis does not fit the service.
coding.prevent: Check that the diagnosis fits the service, and use modifier 25 only for a separate, significant visit on the same day as a procedure.

timely_filing.label: Timely filing
timely_filing.plain: The payer says the claim arrived after its filing limit.
timely_filing.prevent: Send claims well inside each insurer's filing limit, and keep the clearinghouse acceptance report for every claim.

authorization.label: Authorization
authorization.plain: The payer says it had no prior authorization for the service.
authorization.prevent: Get the approval number before the service, and put it on the claim.

duplicate.label: Duplicate
duplicate.plain: The payer thinks the service was billed twice.
duplicate.prevent: Check a claim's status before sending it again, and mark a corrected claim as a correction.

eligibility.label: Eligibility
eligibility.plain: The payer says the patient was not covered on the date of service, or could not be found.
eligibility.prevent: Check coverage on the day of the visit, and copy the front and back of the member ID card.
